operations.description: Requires security_policies.manage. Entries are trimmed, deduplicated and byte ordered (A-Z lower-cased when not case sensitive); a refused entry is validation_error with details.field entries[i] and a reason (too_long, invalid_utf8, control_character, wildcard_too_many_stars, wildcard_only_wildcards, empty); the set as a whole entries with too_many_entries or too_large. match_mode and case_sensitive cannot change later. At most 200 live sets per scope (422 string_set_limit). Audit security.string_set.create.

fields.name: match_mode
fields.type: string: exact / prefix / suffix / contains / wildcard
fields.description: Fixed at creation. prefix compares bytes (/api also matches /apiary); wildcard: * any bytes, ? one byte, at most 3 * and 2000 entries.

fields.name: case_sensitive
fields.description: Fixed at creation. When false A-Z are lower-cased (other letters compare as they are).
